data.name: Limitless Range
data.description: Multiply the range increment on all of your ranged and thrown weapons by 5 feet, and these weapons no longer have a maximum range increment for you. You can throw any melee weapon as if it had a range increment of 20 feet--this increment isn't multiplied by 5, but the weapon doesn't have a maximum range increment.
